source_quotes.quote: clarifies #8/#16/#20/#25/#26: use Q Eq.(4), inputs/Q.txt:399-411, with B reference: \(\mathrm{NA}_{R/B}=\Delta\Delta G(5B\to5R)-\Delta\Delta G(3B\to3R)\), equivalently coefficients \((1,-1,-1,1)\) in order \((5R,5B,3R,3B)\). Negative NA means the R change improves binding more in series 5, corresponding to Q positive coupling (inputs/Q.txt:903-915), not negative cooperativity. The two bound microstates in #8 are assigned to \(5R=5R^{\prime\prime}\); their free-energy reduction gives \(-RT\ln2\). Assigning them instead to \(5B=5R^{\prime}\), \(3R=3R^{\prime\prime}\), or \(3B=3R^{\prime}\) gives respectively \(+RT\ln2,+RT\ln2,-RT\ln2\). The synthetic minimisation-score cycles in #25 and #26 remain -1 in the same signed convention; they favour the series-5 R change in graph units, with #26 pose cycle zero. A/B and F/B have matching labels; any extension across other substituents must use Q Figure 1 mapping \(3G\leftrightarrow5H\) and \(3H\leftrightarrow5I\) (inputs/Q.txt:1392-1394), not automatic same-letter pairing.

progress, extending #44. Endpoint rule frozen in ada/endpoint_big.py (docstring): ligand L is taken only from a bound Complex/core pair L~X in which L is the INITIAL state, removing atoms whose MORPH.pert initial_type is du; coordinates and GAFF types come from SYSTEM.top/crd (read as data, Python -I, no archive code run). Under this rule all four F/B positions have a usable bound starting structure: 5F from 5Series/5F~5C, 5B from 5B~5A, 3F from 3Series/3F~3C, 3B from 3B~3A (top/crd only, no PDB). 3A and 5A occur only as FINAL states (3B~3A, 3D~3A, 3G~3A, 3H~3A; 5B~5A, 5D~5A, 5H~5A, 5I~5A), so their coordinates would be the partner ligand geometry with retyped atoms; under the frozen rule the A/B cycle is NOT constructible and I record that as a limitation rather than projecting. Caveats: these are FESetup minimised/restrained-equilibrated starting poses (inputs/Q.txt Methods, 10 kcal/mol/A^2 restraint), single snapshots, not ensembles or crystal endpoints. MORPH.pert lists only perturbed atoms (40 of 51 for 5F~5C), so types for unchanged atoms must come from the topology, which the script does. Feature rule (not RDKit, which is unavailable here): ligand HD = N/O bearing H; HA = any O or N of GAFF type nb/nc/nd/n2/ne/nf; HP = C bonded only to C/H, or Cl/Br; AR = 5/6-ring centroids of aromatic GAFF types; protein features from fixed residue templates (backbone N/O, polar side chains, aliphatic carbons, aromatic ring centroids); receptor points kept within 5 Angstrom of any ligand heavy atom (P rule, inputs/P.txt:358-366). BIG: vertex weight Table I, strict compatibility \(|d_1-d_2|<\tau+\epsilon_i+\epsilon_j\) with \(\epsilon_s\) for HD/HA-HD/HA vertices, three frozen parameter sets from P Appendices B/C/D. Exact solver: branch-and-bound over ligand points (a clique uses each ligand point at most once), with time limit and completion flag; no heuristic substitution. The exact run is in progress; results will be in ada/endpoint-big-results.json with N=n*m, density, S_L=-W and the raw cycle \(S_{5F}-S_{5B}-S_{3F}+S_{3B}\) (Q Eq.4 sign, #41). No result is claimed yet.

result in the P distance-only domain, superseding the injective-domain cycle in #55 as the P-style answer (#61). Evidence: ada/scripts2/distance_only_big.py, ada/distance-only-big-results.json, ada/distance-only-big.log (Python -I via uv with numpy/scipy; archive read as data; only function defs/constants of ada/endpoint_big.py reused, SHA256 recorded). Appendix B parameters (\(\epsilon=4,\epsilon_s=3,\tau=0.6\)), strict Appendix B margin, no injectivity, frozen #52 features and 5 Angstrom receptor rule. Exact maximum-weight cliques were obtained by HiGHS MILP (edge formulation), all four with status Optimal inside the 90 s limit, and each returned clique was checked pairwise as a clique. \(W\) for (5F,5B,3F,3B) = (41.0582, 35.8431, 36.8334, 35.2678) on graphs of N = (731,560,663,574) vertices, density 0.82-0.84. Clique sizes are (190,154,169,160) vertices; every ligand point is used, together with 26, 26, 29 and 24 receptor points. Raw dimensionless cycle \(C=S_{5F}-S_{5B}-S_{3F}+S_{3B}\) with \(S=-W\) (Q Eq. 4 sign, #41) = \(-3.6495\). Certified interval from the dual bounds: \([-3.6495,-3.6491]\), so the sign is resolved and negative, the same sign as the experimental \(-1.6\) kcal/mol (Q positive coupling). Decomposition: series-3 R effect \(S_{3F}-S_{3B}=-1.566\), series-5 R effect \(S_{5F}-S_{5B}=-5.215\), X effect \(S_{5B}-S_{3B}=-0.575\). Emmy greedy certificates in #62 (34.68, 34.05, 30.99, 32.69) are 6.4%, 5.0%, 15.9% and 7.3% below these optima, so the greedy cycle (\(-1.35\)) had the wrong magnitude. That is an instance of #11: per-ligand optimisation residuals do not cancel in the cycle. Graph units are not kcal/mol, and no calibration exists (#47).
